welcome.understandInfo.1: Click a function, variable, or type name in the editor and its attributes appear here.
welcome.understandAnnotationBrowser.1:
Every annotation in the project — notes and ignored violations — grouped by file, author, template, or date.
Use Group Annotations By... in this view's title bar to regroup.
welcome.understandViolationsList.1:
The project's analysis errors and warnings, and every violation the background CodeChecks found, grouped by file, check, severity, or entity.
Analyze the project to fill it, use Group Violations By... in this view's title bar to regroup, and the filter button to show only the current file's.
welcome.understandViolationsList.2:
This project has no analysis errors or warnings.
Your license does not include CodeCheck, so this view lists only what analysis finds.
welcome.understandViolationsList.3:
This project has no violations.
This view lists what Understand's background CodeChecks find. To turn them on, open the project in Understand, choose Checks > Select Checks, pick a configuration, and turn on Run in Background. Violations appear here after the next analysis.
[How to run CodeCheck in the background](https://docs.scitools.com/help/codecheck/background-checks.html)
welcome.understandViolationsList.4:
The current file has no violations.
Use the filter button in this view's title bar to show the whole project's.
config.Understand.title: Understand
config.understand.ai.chatSize.descriptio: Open a chat with full width or half width
config.understand.aiView.enabled.descrip: Show content of the AI view
config.understand.aiView.automaticallyGe: Generate an AI Overview for every card the AI Overview view shows, as Understand's AI Overview window does, instead of waiting for a click. The view's title bar toggles this.
config.understand.analysis.automatically: Automatically analyze on project open, file save/create/delete
config.understand.hover.markdownDescript: Text to show in the hover for each kind of entity, in place of the declaration Understand writes. Each key is a kind filter, spelled the way kind filters are everywhere else: `Function` matches every language, `Python Function` narrows to one, a comma separates alternatives and `~` excludes. Where more than one key matches, the narrowest one wins, so `Python Function` beats `Function`; a kind no key matches keeps the built-in declaration. The text may use `{name}`, `{longname}`, `{kind}`, `{type}`, `{parameters}` and `{value}`; a placeholder the entity has nothing for comes out empty. The result is shown as code in the file's language, so it is coloured as code even when it is not.
config.understand.annotations.enabled.de: Show annotations in VS Code: the gutter icons and scrollbar marks, the hover and Annotate lens, the Annotations view, and the annotation menu items. Off hides all of them without touching the annotations themselves.
config.understand.annotations.gutterIcon: Mark annotated lines with an icon in the gutter and on the scrollbar. Off leaves the annotations, the hover and the Annotations view in place.
config.understand.annotationBrowser.enab: Show the Annotations view, every annotation in the project
config.understand.fileDecorations.enable: Mark each file name with its Understand status: a badge in the explorer, on the editor tab and in Open Editors for a project file that needs analyzing, and a muted colour for a file that is not in the project
config.understand.violationsView.enabled: Show content of the Violations view
config.understand.files.watch.markdownDe: [Glob pattern](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) of files to watch, to notify the server when they are changed/created/deleted, for example `**/src/**/*.{c,h}`
config.understand.infoView.enabled.descr: Show content of the Info view
config.understand.graphsView.enabled.des: Show content of the Graphs view
config.understand.graphs.reuseTab.descri: Open a graph in the active graph tab instead of a new one, as the graph window's Reuse checkbox does
config.understand.license.code.descripti: License code for the language server, passed to it as the UNDERSTAND_LICENSE_CODE environment variable: used for this server only and never written to the shared license configuration. Intended for containers and other environments where running `und -setlicensecode` is inconvenient
config.understand.license.deregisterOnEx: When the language server stops, release this machine's installation of the license code on the license server. Combine with the license code setting in a container so that an exiting container never leaves a license registered
config.understand.metricsView.disabledMe: API names of [metrics](https://support.scitools.com/support/solutions/articles/70000582223-what-metrics-does-understand-have-) to hide (example: AvgCountLine). By default, the Git metrics: they read the repository's whole history, which takes minutes on a large one.
config.understand.metricsView.enabled.de: Show content of the Metrics view
config.understand.project.path.descripti: Absolute path of the Understand project (PROJECT_NAME.und folder, most likely should be configured in Workspace/Folder Settings)
config.understand.project.pathFindingMet: Either allow the language server to find the Understand project automatically, or manually set it once
config.understand.referencesView.enabled: Show content of the References view
config.understand.referencesView.preserv: Enable to keep focus on the References view, otherwise focus on the editor
config.understand.server.communicationPr: Way to communicate with the language server
config.understand.server.communicationTc: TCP port used if the communication protocol is TCP socket
config.understand.server.executable.desc: Command or full path of `userver`, the Understand Language server
config.understand.trace.server.descripti: Log trace for communication with the language server
config.understand.violations.hover.detai: Preview the detailed description of a violation when the mouse hovers on it in the editor
